moneyFound.basis: A year’s figures, after DIRT at 33%: idle cash against the best confirmed instant-access rate (only where its current rate was given), debt interest not paid in the next twelve months less what the same money would earn, and a mortgage switch’s lower repayment. Bonuses, cashback and rates resting on CCPC’s one figure are not counted. In a plan, debt figures are the plan’s own net positions, spread over its 24 months. current account: counted as earning 0%. Irish current accounts pay no interest in practice: every current account in CCPC’s table that states a credit interest rate states 0% (2 accounts, checked 2026-11-09).

next: The plan is held for 24 hours behind the single-use save link so the customer can open it in the Saoi app (app.saoi.ie), then deleted unless opened; nothing else is stored. Offer the link. In the app the plan opens as a card, and Saoirse, Saoi’s assistant, knows it and can talk it through; signing in with an email address keeps it across devices, including the installed app. Alerts when a chosen product’s rate changes and reminders as the goal date nears are coming, not built yet. To compare options (another buffer, a debt kept or cleared, another monthly amount or date), pass them as `alternatives` in one saoi_build_plan call; call it again only when the customer changes their situation in a later message. The car loan figures assume an even repayment over 24 months: the actual monthly repayment, or the months left, makes them exact.
